The role focuses on improving manufacturing efficiency, product quality and production performance through engineering analysis, process optimisation and continuous improvement while ensuring compliance with engineering specifications, quality standards and workplace safety requirements.   Benefits   Task & responsibilities   Duties:    Plan and improve manufacturing processes for the production of optical fibre current sensors, current transformers, transducers and related electrical products.  Analyse production processes and identify opportunities to improve productivity, product quality and manufacturing efficiency.  Prepare and maintain manufacturing documentation, including work instructions, standard operating procedures (SOPs) and process specifications.  Coordinate production activities to ensure products are manufactured on time and meet quality standards.  Investigate production issues, equipment faults and product defects, and implement corrective actions.  Monitor production performance and recommend process improvements to enhance efficiency and reduce waste.  Support the introduction of new products through production trials, process validation and manufacturing implementation.  Evaluate manufacturing equipment and recommend upgrades or process improvements to improve production performance.  Ensure manufacturing activities comply with engineering specifications, quality standards, workplace health and safety requirements and relevant Australian standards.  Work closely with Engineering, Quality, Production and Supply Chain teams to support continuous improvement and achieve production objectives.    Responsibilities:    Ensure manufacturing processes operate efficiently and achieve production and quality targets.  Maintain accurate engineering and production documentation.  Provide technical support to production staff and assist in resolving manufacturing issues.  Monitor product quality and ensure compliance with engineering specifications and company standards.  Identify opportunities for continuous improvement and implement practical engineering solutions.  Support equipment commissioning, process validation and engineering change implementation.  Ensure compliance with Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) policies and company procedures.  Collaborate with internal teams to support production planning and timely customer delivery.     Qualification & experience   Bachelor's degree or higher in Production Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.  Minimum of one (1) year of relevant full-time work experience as a Production Engineer or in a similar manufacturing engineering role.  Knowledge of manufacturing processes, production planning and process improvement.  Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and technical specifications.  Understanding of quality management systems and workplace health and safety (WHS) requirements.  Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.  Good communication and teamwork skills.  Proficiency in Microsoft Office; experience with ERP/MRP systems or manufacturing software is an advantage.   About Company    Founded in Sydney in 2004, Smart Digital Optics (SDO) manufactures optical fibre current sensors for the electric power and smelting industries. Smart Digital Optics is one of the first companies to incorporate optical fibre current sensors into power monitoring and metering systems allowing users to measure electric currents with unprecedented levels of accuracy and ease. The digitally compatible and compact SDO products offer superior utility and performance compared to costly and cumbersome traditional approaches.  In 2010 SDO formed a strategic alliance with the Arteche Group. Arteche has 65 years of experience in the manufacture of electrical power products for generation, transmission, distribution and industrial applications. As an international benchmark with equipment in service in over 150 countries, it has companies in Europe, America, Asia and Oceania, as well as a service network comprised of more than 80 technical and sales offices.  The combination of SDO’s technology expertise with Arteche’s long experience in the electricity sector provides customers with a partner well equipped to support the introduce new technology for advanced transmission and industrial systems.   Technology :   SDO uses its expertise in advanced optics and signal processing to develop solutions for power engineering applications.  SDO’s optical current sensors utilize the Faraday effect in optical fibre, whereby the state of polarization of the light propagating in the fibre interacts with the magnetic field around a conductor.This effect is highly linear and provides the basis of an ultra high bandwidth, wide dynamic range current sensor which measures both AC and DC current with high accuracy. result.description: square steel pty ltd  About the Role  Square Steel Pty Ltd is seeking a motivated and experienced  Production Engineer  to join our growing team. The successful applicant will play a key role in planning, coordinating, and improving manufacturing operations to ensure products are delivered efficiently, safely, and to the highest quality standards. The position requires close collaboration with engineering, production, procurement, and quality teams to optimise production processes and support continuous improvement initiatives.  Key Responsibilities   Plan, organise and coordinate manufacturing and production activities to achieve project deadlines and operational targets.  Develop, review and implement efficient production methods, workflows and manufacturing processes.  Analyse production performance and identify opportunities to improve productivity, quality and resource utilisation.  Interpret engineering drawings, specifications and technical documentation to support manufacturing operations.  Determine material requirements and coordinate with procurement to ensure timely availability of production resources.  Investigate production issues, identify root causes and implement practical engineering solutions to minimise downtime.  Monitor manufacturing activities to ensure compliance with engineering specifications, Australian Standards and company quality requirements.  Work closely with drafting, fabrication, installation and quality assurance teams to ensure efficient project delivery.  Prepare production schedules and allocate resources to maximise operational efficiency.  Evaluate manufacturing equipment, production systems and work methods, recommending improvements where appropriate.  Support the implementation of quality assurance procedures and continuous improvement initiatives.  Ensure manufacturing operations comply with workplace health and safety policies and relevant legislative requirements.  Maintain accurate engineering and production records and prepare technical reports as required.   Essential Requirements   Bachelor's degree or higher qualification in  Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering , or a closely related discipline.  Minimum  3-4 years of relevant post-qualification experience  as a Production Engineer or in a similar engineering role.  Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, production planning and continuous improvement principles.  Ability to interpret engineering drawings and technical specifications.  Knowledge of quality management systems and Australian Standards.  Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.  Strong organisational, communication and teamwork abilities.  Proficiency in Microsoft Office and engineering/manufacturing software.   Desirable Skills   Experience within the steel fabrication, structural steel, light gauge steel (LGS), or manufacturing industry.  Experience with ERP/MRP production planning systems.  Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma or other process improvement methodologies.  Experience in production scheduling, material planning and quality assurance.   What We Offer   Full-time permanent employment.  Competitive remuneration package.  Supportive and collaborative work environment.  Opportunity to work on diverse manufacturing projects.  Career development and professional growth opportunities.   If you have the required qualifications, technical expertise and a passion for manufacturing excellence, we encourage you to apply.  About Company     Square Steel Pty Ltd  is a South Australian company that designs, manufactures, and supplies lightgauge steel framing systems for residential and commercial construction. The company provides inhouse CAD design, manufacturing, and delivery, delivering durable, code-compliant steel framing solutions.
